tagline: Fair, rule-based parking. Booking early earns no advantage.

login.title: Sign in
login.ssoHint: You'll be sent to your company's sign-in page.
login.devHint: Development only. Pick a seeded user.

site.title: Site setup
site.roundsHint: All times are in the site's time zone ({{tz}}). Changes apply to the next scheduled run.
site.dailyHint: Runs on the working day before (Friday for Monday).
site.poolHint: Car and EV bays held back for last-minute requests.
site.graceHint: Unclaimed bays are released after this. Max 30.
site.maxFactorHint: No single factor may exceed this.
site.autoPublish: Publish unapproved rounds at 07:00 on the day (safety valve)
site.evOverflow: Same-day: offer unused EV bays to car requests
site.requirePlate: Vehicle number required (only if the gate needs it)
site.backupAdmins: Backup admins who can approve rounds
site.blocksHint: Block bays for events or documented reserved use. Employees see the reason.
site.approvalsHint: Only the approval and its end date are stored. Never record medical details here.

policy.title: Allocation policy
policy.nextRound: A policy published now takes effect from the week of {{week}}.
policy.effectiveFrom: In force from the week of {{week}}.
policy.draftHint: Edit weights and settings, save, then publish. Feasibility updates as you type.
policy.discardConfirm: Discard this draft? This can't be undone.
policy.publishHint: Takes effect from the next weekly round: the week of {{week}}. Never mid-round.
policy.blocked: Fix the problems marked ⛔ before publishing.

errors.forbidden: You don't have access to this page.

booking.title: Request a bay
booking.fairness: Bays are allocated by published rules in scheduled rounds. Requesting early gives no advantage, so request whenever suits you.
booking.pickDaysHint: Tap one or more days. Greyed-out days are closed.
booking.typeOnlyHint: If no {{type}} bay is left, you'd otherwise be offered a car bay.
booking.reasonHint: Business need adds to your score. Claims are spot-checked.
booking.decidedSameDay: {{round}} at {{runAt}} · you'll get an offer to accept
booking.requestedOk: Requested {{count}} day(s). You'll hear when the round runs.
booking.upcomingHint: Change or withdraw freely until the round that decides it runs.
booking.recurringHint: Your usual office days. Each week's requests are made for you before the weekly round; skip any day you won't come in.
booking.awaitingResults: Round has run — results by {{time}} after admin review
booking.cancelConfirm: Cancel this booking? The bay goes to someone else.

rounds.collationHint: Requests against supply for the next working days. Ratios above 1× mean more requests than allocatable bays.
rounds.ratioHint: Allocatable = supply − bays held back for the same-day pool.
rounds.title: Rounds
rounds.hint: Weekly rounds run Friday, daily rounds the evening before, same-day rounds every 30 minutes on the day.
rounds.reviewSoon: Reviewing and approving rounds arrives next (M5). Until then, pending rounds publish at 07:00 on their first day.

review.deadline: Approve by {{time}}. Otherwise it publishes at 07:00 on its first day.
review.note: Note (optional, recorded in the audit log)

audit.title: Audit log
audit.hint: Every allocation, override, release and policy change, with who, when and why. Kept for 12 months.

checkin.autoReleased: Released: nobody checked in by the deadline, so the bay went to someone else.
checkin.checkInBy: Check in by {{time}}, or the bay is released
checkin.qrHint: Show this at the gate. Bay {{bay}}. Valid today only.
checkin.noToken: This link is missing its bay code. Scan the sticker again.

gate.title: Gate
gate.scanHint: Scan the employee's QR code with the camera, or with a handheld scanner into the box below.
gate.cameraError: Camera unavailable ({{error}}). Use a handheld scanner or type the code.

sticker.caption: Scan with your phone camera when you park here to check in.

consent.title: Before you start
consent.intro: ParkSmart needs your consent to use your parking data. You can read the rules first.
consent.point1: Only your requests, bookings and check-ins are used, and only to allocate bays.
consent.point2: Booking early never helps, and nothing about you is sold or shared.
consent.point3: You can download your data or delete your account at any time from your profile.

profile.title: Profile
profile.vehiclesHint: Tell us if you drive an EV so you can request a charging bay. No plate needed.
profile.vehiclesHintPlate: This site's gate needs a number plate. Mark EVs to request a charging bay.
profile.vehicleConsentNeeded: To add a vehicle, first allow "Vehicle details" under Consent below.
profile.distanceWhy: Why we ask: if your site's rules give weight to long commutes, this band can raise your score. Only the band is stored, never your address.
profile.distanceSkip: Skipping is fine. You will simply get no distance points.
profile.consentsHint: What we use your data for. Optional items can be switched off at any time.
profile.requiredConsent: Needed to use ParkSmart. To withdraw it, delete your account.
profile.revokeVehicles: Switching this off deletes your saved vehicles.
profile.dataHint: Download everything we hold about you, or delete your account.
profile.deleteConfirm: This cancels your future bookings, withdraws open requests, and removes your vehicles, profile and notifications. Past allocation records stay anonymised for the audit trail. This cannot be undone.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.hint: Pilot metrics for a month. Days in the future show no data yet.
analytics.fairnessTarget: People with under 60% of peak-day requests met
analytics.dailyHint: Bays used by a checked-in car, out of {{bays}} active bays.
